About the role:
This is a highly specialized position requiring deep expertise in end-to-end software architecture and full-stack development across fintech, SaaS, proptech, AI, and blockchain domains. The ideal candidate has served as a primary software architect across multiple greenfield platforms and has held CTO-level technical leadership responsibilities while remaining hands-on.

Key responsibilities:
• Serve as primary software architect for greenfield platform development across multiple industry verticals
• Design and own end-to-end system architecture including TypeScript frontend applications, Fastify backend services, PostgreSQL database modeling, and cloud infrastructure
• Implement multi-tenant architectures with physically isolated tenant infrastructure including dedicated backend services, databases, and document storage
• Design asynchronous processing systems and business-critical workflows using React, Fastify, and PostgreSQL
• Integrate AI-powered document extraction and processing using Anthropic Claude API and AWS Bedrock
• Build event-driven workflows for reconciliation, notifications, auditing, and asynchronous operations
• Design and implement digital asset pipelines including watermarking, file preparation, and secure content delivery
• Integrate payment systems, KYC processes, and financial reconciliation workflows
• Provide technical consulting on architecture, security, scalability, and product development
• Lead technical design decisions involving reliability, security, scalability, maintainability, and delivery constraints

Mandatory qualifications:
• Masters degree or equivalent in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field (Postgraduate Diploma in AI/ML preferred)
• Minimum 10 years of professional software development experience
• Demonstrated experience as CTO or equivalent technical leadership role
• Proven track record as primary architect for multiple greenfield software platforms
• Expert-level proficiency in: React, Next.js, React Server Components, TanStack, TypeScript, JavaScript
• Expert-level proficiency in: Node.js, FastifyJS, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, REST, GraphQL
• Expert-level proficiency in: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (including Bedrock and SageMaker)
• Experience designing physically isolated multi-tenant SaaS architectures with dedicated backend services, databases, and document storage per tenant
• Experience integrating Anthropic Claude API for AI-assisted document extraction and processing
• Experience building multi-currency digital commerce platforms with automated payment verification and asset fulfillment
• Experience with Ethers, Viem, Wagmi, Hardhat, and Truffle for blockchain development
• Experience leading and managing globally distributed engineering teams across multiple countries
• Experience restructuring engineering organizations around codebase and domain ownership
• Experience establishing standardized technical interview frameworks and assessment processes
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written

What you'll do:
You will plan, coordinate and oversee the infrastructure and services that ensure the efficient flow of goods and people to, from and within the Organization, in compliance with applicable safety rules and procedures. You will apply best practices and contribute to the continuous improvement of logistics and operational processes, covering areas such as warehouse and inventory management, goods reception, process optimisation, ERP-based operational follow-up, KPI monitoring and the supervision of subcontracted activities.

Your responsibilities:
- Plan, coordinate and optimise the delivery of logistics and warehouse services, assisting operational teams, including the contractor's team, in ensuring quality, safety and efficiency of logistics services.
- Act as interface between logistics actors, including warehouse teams, procurement, technical support and various service providers, maintaining regular communication with end users at CERN and ensuring a high level of customer service.
- Monitor operational and contractor performance, including KPIs, invoicing, payment controls, audits and related activities.
- Oversee CERN Store replenishment activities in strong collaboration with the CERN Referencing team, and provide support on ERP-related questions and improvements.
- Participate in and lead logistics-related projects in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. Permanent employment with stable and supportive workplaces

EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine, equivalent to Swedish standards
Good communication skills in English

We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

We care about ability, judgment, ownership, and evidence of what you have built. We do not require a particular degree, pedigree, previous title, or arbitrary number of years of experience.

jobs.occupation: Talent Sourcer for a Leading Fashion Company
jobs.description:
Do you want to help identify and attract creative talent for one of Sweden’s most well-known fashion companies? We are currently looking for a Talent Sourcer, apply today!
About the role
Our client is an international Swedish fashion company headquartered in central Stockholm. As a Talent Sourcer, you will work closely with the recruitment team and support the early stages of the recruitment process, focusing on building candidate pipelines, scheduling interviews, and ensuring a high pace of delivery.
You will primarily support high-volume recruitment within creative functions, such as design and product-related roles, where multiple positions need to be filled within a short timeframe. You will join a driven and collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, teamwork, and a positive work environment.
Work tasks
In this role, you will:
Identify and engage relevant candidates through proactive sourcing activities.
Conduct initial screening interviews.
Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and recruiters.
Ensure candidate information and recruitment processes are accurately maintained within the recruitment system.
Contribute to building strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

For the right candidate, there will be opportunities to take on greater ownership of the recruitment process.
We are looking for
Has previous experience in sourcing and recruitment.
Experience recruiting for creative roles is considered an advantage.
Is structured, self-driven, and comfortable working towards clear targets.
Has excellent communication skills and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Is fluent in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.

As a person, you enjoy working in a goal-oriented recruitment environment where you can drive processes forward, identify the right talent, and create results. You are service-minded, quality-focused, flexible, and adaptable.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Help Build the Next Generation of Mathematics Learning
Albert Group is a Nordic EdTech group developing digital education services that help children learn and grow. Through Albert Junior and Sumdog, the group has established experience in digital learning for both home and school.
Albert Group is now developing a new AI-powered mathematics platform designed to make learning more personalised, engaging and effective.
The platform will offer two complementary services. For schools, the focus is on providing teachers with better tools for instruction, classroom activities and understanding students' learning progress. For home use, a standalone service is being developed where children can learn new mathematical concepts, practise their skills and receive personalised support through AI.
Both services will work independently while also having the potential to complement each other and strengthen children's learning.
For this initiative, E-commerce Recruit is looking for a VP AI Ventures to take overall responsibility for developing the product, building the business and bringing the offering to market.
About the Role
You will take full ownership of developing the new business, from product strategy and technical priorities to launch and commercial growth.
The product is already under development. Your role will be to take it forward, establish clear priorities and ensure that technology is translated into valuable, commercially viable services.
You will lead a small team with expertise in technology and education, while also working with external developers and specialists. The role involves close collaboration with other businesses within the group and reports directly to the CEO.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Own the product strategy, roadmap and priorities for the AI-powered platform.
Lead internal developers, educational specialists and external consultants, while driving key technical decisions.
Ensure the product is grounded in relevant educational research and that technology supports learning.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies targeting both schools (B2B) and parents (B2C).
Take responsibility for the business model, positioning, pricing and commercial launch.
Drive pilot programmes and measure learning outcomes, user engagement and business performance.
Build the team and business step by step, with responsibility for budget and results.
Develop the business with international expansion in mind, initially focusing on the Nordic markets and the UK.

During your first months, you will familiarise yourself with the existing product development work and establish a clear product and go-to-market plan. The next priorities will be to launch pilots, measure results and create the conditions for acquiring paying customers.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for someone who has experience building, developing and launching digital products or new business areas, and who understands what it takes to turn an early-stage idea into a viable business.
You have a strong technical understanding and hands-on experience with AI-powered products. You do not need to write the code yourself, but you must be able to understand technical opportunities, challenge development teams and make well-informed decisions.
You also bring a strong commercial mindset and experience turning product ideas into offerings that customers want to use and are willing to pay for.
We believe you have:
Experience building and launching digital products, preferably within SaaS, with responsibility for both product development and commercial results.
Hands-on experience with AI products, such as LLM-based features, prompt engineering, evaluation or personalisation.
Experience leading developers, product teams or external technology partners.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies.
A data-driven approach based on testing hypotheses, measuring results and making informed decisions.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Swedish is highly preferred, but we welcome strong candidates who speak English only.

Experience in EdTech, consumer applications or international digital services is an advantage. A background in startups, entrepreneurship, the UK education market or data protection is also valuable.
Your Personality and Approach
To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable operating in an environment where not all the answers are available from the start.
You are used to making decisions with limited information, testing solutions and adjusting direction based on what you learn. You know how to prioritise and recognise when a product is ready to be tested in the market.
You are equally comfortable working strategically on long-term product direction and getting hands-on to solve practical challenges alongside the development team.
You are curious, open-minded and quick to learn new subjects. You communicate effectively with technical specialists, educators and senior management alike.
What matters most is your ability to take ownership, build momentum and turn ideas into results.
About Albert Group
Albert Group is a Nordic EdTech group developing digital education services for children and students. Through brands including Albert Junior, Swedish Film and Sumdog, the group provides learning solutions for both home and school.
With experience across consumer and education markets, Albert Group has established a foundation for continued product development. The group is now taking its next step into AI-powered mathematics learning, with international ambitions.
Learn more at the-albertgroup.com (https://the-albertgroup.com/).
Location and Application
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
This recruitment is managed by E-commerce Recruit in close collaboration with Albert Group.
The recruitment process includes initial interviews and discussions with the company. For shortlisted candidates, a work-related case, assessments and reference checks may also be included.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.employer_name: Moses Bil o Lack Tollarp AB
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsbeskrivning
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB är beläget strax söder om Kristianstad och erbjuder skade- och lackreparationer för försäkringsbolag, företag och privatpersoner. Med omkring 65 engagerade medarbetare är vi en av regionens ledande aktörer inom bilskadereparation.
Vår verksamhet bedrivs i rymliga, moderna lokaler där vi erbjuder ett komplett serviceutbud – från reparation och lackering till skadehantering för personbilar, husbilar och hästlastbilar.
Vi är auktoriserad skadeverkstad för Volkswagen, Škoda, Volkswagen Transportbilar, SEAT och Tesla, samtidigt som vi välkomnar och reparerar fordon av samtliga bilmärken.
Vi är särskilt stolta över att ha fått förtroendet att förbereda och lackera de exklusiva karossdelarna från Koenigsegg. Detta uppdrag är ett kvitto på vår höga kompetens, vårt kompromisslösa kvalitetsfokus och vår ambition att ständigt utvecklas. För oss är varje uppdrag unikt, och vårt mål är alltid detsamma – att leverera ett resultat med högsta precision och kvalitet som överträffar kundens förväntningar.
Arbetsuppgifter
Arbetet omfattar alla typer av plåtskador, karossreparationer och plåtarbeten.
Som bilplåtslagare hos Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB erbjuds du ett varierande och ansvarsfullt arbete där du självständigt utför olika typer av plåt- och karossarbeten.
Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat reparation av plåtskador, karossreparationer, riktningsarbeten i riktbänk, byte av reservdelar samt övriga plåt- och karossarbeten. Du kommer att arbeta med både mindre och mer omfattande skadereparationer och säkerställa att arbetet utförs med hög kvalitet.
Arbetsuppgifterna anpassas efter din kompetens, erfarenhet och utveckling i rollen.
Utbildning/Erfarenhet
Vi söker en erfaren och engagerad bilplåtslagare/skadereparatör som vill bli en del av vårt team och bidra till att vi fortsätter leverera hög kvalitet och god service till våra kunder.
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av bilplåtslageri, gärna med relevant utbildning inom yrket. Även du som har praktisk erfarenhet och ett stort intresse för yrket är välkommen att söka.
Som person är du noggrann, ansvarstagande och kvalitetsmedveten. Du arbetar självständigt, tar eget ansvar och har samtidigt en god samarbetsförmåga. Du trivs med att arbeta i ett team där man stöttar varandra och tillsammans skapar de bästa resultaten.
Hos oss får du ett varierande arbete i en väletablerad verksamhet med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en trygg arbetsmiljö.
För dig som behöver finns även möjlighet till kollektivt boende på bekvämt gångavstånd från arbetsplatsen.
VACANCY NOTICE IN ENGLISH
Car platers / Auto body mechanichs for work in Sweden.
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB is located just south of Kristianstad and offers damage and paint repairs for insurance companies, companies and private individuals. With around 65 dedicated employees, we are one of the region's leading players in car damage repair.
Our business is conducted in spacious, modern premises where we offer a complete range of services - from repair and painting to damage management for passenger cars, motorhomes and horse trucks.
We are an authorized damage repair workshop for Volkswagen, Škoda, Volkswagen Transportbilar, SEAT and Tesla, while also welcoming and repairing vehicles of all car brands.
We are particularly proud to have been entrusted with preparing and painting the exclusive cars from Koenigsegg. This assignment is a testament to our high level of expertise, our uncompromising focus on quality and our ambition to constantly develop. For us, every assignment is unique, and our goal is always the same - to deliver a result with the highest precision and quality that exceeds the customer's expectations.
Duties:
The work includes all types of sheet metal damage, body repairs and sheet metal work.
As a car body repairer at Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB, you are offered a varied and responsible job where you independently perform different types of sheet metal and body work.
Your tasks include, among other things, repairing sheet metal damage, body repairs, straightening work in a straightening bench, replacing spare parts and other sheet metal and body work. You will work with both minor and more extensive damage repairs and ensure that the work is carried out with high quality.
The tasks are adapted to your skills, experience and development in the role.
Competence:
We are now looking for auto body mechanics to meet our customers' needs and strengthen our team. We are looking for you who have experience in auto body work, preferably with training in the profession or someone who is interested in the profession and has some experience within the field.
You are careful and responsible with great patience. You enjoy working in an independent role, but at the same time you are also an obvious team player.
We offer you good earnings and development opportunities and a good working environment in awell-established and state-of-the-art equipment. We would rather see results and experience than formal education. English on a basic level is desirable.
Personal characteristics:
Flexible, reliable, dedicated and quality aware are key words for you and for us. You must have an eye for details and work with precision, even in stressful situations.
Relocation package / Accommodation: We are offering accommodation to the successful candidate/s. The accommodation is very close (walking distance) and is owned by the employer. The employer will also help you with administrative issues about living and working in Sweden.
The services may be added before the application deadline expires.
If you have any further questions please do not hesitate to contact us.
If the description fits you, please send us your application with qualifications and a short description of yourself. The application should be sent by E-mail: mose@moses.se. 
Applications is being reviewed when received. Therefore the vacancy can be filled before the last date to apply.
